sloka: कति दुर्गाणि दुर्गाया लंकायास् तद् ब्रवीहि मे ।ज्ञातुम् इच्चामि तत् सर्वम् दर्शनाद् इव वानर ॥६-३-३॥।।
transliteration: kati durgāṇi durgāyā laṁkāyās tad bravīhi me ।jñātum iccāmi tat sarvam darśanād iva vānara ॥6-3-3॥।।

translations.english: "O Vanara How many forts are in Lanka? You may tell me whatever you have seen. I wish to know all that."
